mapper.select: select t.pk_id, t.rd_project_contract_id, t.rd_project_id, t.ratio, t.create_by, t.create_date, t.update_by, t.update_date, p.project_code, p.project_name, c.budget_code, c.budget_name from ppm.rd_project_contract_relation t left join ppm.rd_project p on p.pk_id=t.rd_project_id left join ppm.rd_project_contract c on c.pk_id = t.rd_project_contract_id where 1=1 and t.rd_project_id = #{req.rdProjectId} and t.rd_project_contract_id = #{req.rdProjectContractId} order by nvl(t.update_date,t.create_date) desc
